title: Rooms & Room Management
description: Virtual classrooms where teachers organize and conduct interactive sessions with students

teacher.overview: Rooms are your virtual classrooms where you organize and conduct sessions. Each room has a unique code that students use to join.

create: Go to Dashboard and click 'Create Room' button
Share the unique room code with students
manage: View all your rooms on the Dashboard
Click on a room to see details and session history
Edit room name or description anytime
Archive rooms you no longer need
View list of students who joined the room
startSession: Open the room from your Dashboard
Session begins - students can now join
Use the session to create polls, Q&A, and gather feedback

tips: Use clear, descriptive room names (e.g., 'Math Grade 10 - Room A' instead of just 'Math')
Create separate rooms for different subjects or class sections
Share room codes via email, LMS, or display on screen
Archive old rooms to keep your dashboard organized
canDo: Rename or edit room details anytime
Start multiple sessions in the same room
View complete session history for each room
cannotDo: Transfer room ownership to another teacher
bestPractices: Create one room per course or subject
Keep room codes secure - only share with enrolled students
Review session history regularly to track engagement
Use descriptive names to help students identify the right room

student.overview: Rooms are virtual classrooms where you join sessions hosted by your teachers. You need a room code to join.

join: Get the room code from your teacher
Click 'Join' - you're now part of the room
Wait for teacher to start a session to participate
participate: Check your Dashboard to see all joined rooms
Click on a room to view details
Join active sessions when teacher starts them
View your participation history in each room

tips: Save room codes in your notes for quick access
Check room names to ensure you're joining the correct class
You can join multiple rooms for different subjects
Check Dashboard regularly for active sessions
canDo: View all your joined rooms on Dashboard
See session history for rooms you're in
Leave a room if you joined by mistake
cannotDo: See other students in the room before session starts

commonIssues.solution: Double-check the code with your teacher, ensure no extra spaces, verify you copied the entire code
Check your Dashboard - you may have already joined. If not, try logging out and back in
Refresh the page, ensure you successfully joined, check if teacher archived the room
